ai_summary: This financial document from ABB India Limited announces a significant special dividend of Rs. 90 per share (4500% of face value), payable by August 29, 2026, to shareholders of record on August 7, 2026. This substantial payout will materially benefit shareholders through an immediate cash return, while simultaneously reducing the company's cash reserves. Although positive for investors, its "special" nature implies a one-time distribution rather than a recurring commitment, with no obvious red flags in the announcement itself.
